title: Anomaly Engine asset manifest
description: The licence record for every asset this project ships. Structural validation only: whether a licence is *acceptable* is decided by tools/license-gate.mjs against ALLOWED/FORBIDDEN, because duplicating that allow-list here would create a second copy of a fact that can drift. The gate is also the only thing that checks the referenced files exist and that copied files still match their source.

policy.description: Why some licences are accepted and others are not. Read by humans; the machine-enforceable version of it is ALLOWED and FORBIDDEN in tools/license-gate.mjs.

httpsUrl.description: https only, so the licence can still be re-verified later. The gate enforces this too.

relativePath.description: Repository-relative, forward slashes, not absolute. The gate normalises to forward slashes and lower-cases before matching.

asset.description: One shipped file, or one directory that is shipped as a whole.

path.description: File or directory, relative to the repository root. A path listed here that does not exist fails the gate, which is why no 3D model is declared before one exists.

license.description: An identifier from ALLOWED in tools/license-gate.mjs. Not an enum here on purpose: the allow-list has exactly one home.

copiedFrom.description: Set when this file is a byte-identical copy of another manifest entry -- the Vite public directory's copy of a bundled font. The gate then inherits the source record's licence and verifies the bytes still match, instead of trusting a second description of the same bytes.

licenseText.description: Bundled copy of the licence, so it ships with the asset as most licences require.

reservedFontName.description: Required to be accurate for OFL: renaming a modified font is only mandatory when the licence declares a Reserved Font Name.

attribution.description: Required by the gate for any CC-BY licence.

source.description: A third-party source that was evaluated and accepted, with the terms verified on a stated date.

verifiedOn.description: Licences change. This is the date the terms above were read, so a stale entry is visible rather than implied to be current.

quote.description: The licence text this verdict rests on, quoted so a later reader can see what was actually relied upon.

rejectedSource.description: A source that was evaluated and turned down, and the reason, so nobody re-litigates it.
